key_decisions: ChatProvider wraps only ChatPage — chat state is ephemeral, no reason to pollute global context
ConfigProvider wraps only ConfigEditorPage — dirty state + validation is page-local
DashboardProvider stays global — agents/status/logs are needed on every page for Header indicators
DashboardLayout becomes the route shell — sidebar navigation + content area
ErrorBoundary wraps each page to isolate failures

routing_plan.strategy: Hash router avoided — use BrowserRouter since Vite dev proxy handles /api. All 8 routes are top-level children of DashboardLayout.
routing_plan.layout: DashboardLayout provides persistent sidebar nav (left, 200px) + scrollable content area (right). Header stays above both.
routing_plan.lazy_loading: React.lazy() for all page components — they're independent, no shared preload needed. Suspense fallback = pixel loading spinner.
routing_plan.transitions: framer-motion AnimatePresence on <Outlet/> with fade + slight slide-up (150ms). Matches existing animation feel.

state_management.approach: React Context + useReducer — no new library. Already works, team knows it, zero bundle cost.

DashboardContext (existing, global).scope: Wraps entire app. Used by Header, ConnectionIndicator, Overview, WorkersMonitor, TaskManager.

state.circuitBreakers: Record<string, CircuitState> — add to existing state
state.tokens: { input, output } — add to existing state
state.eta: string | null — add to existing state

ChatContext (new, page-scoped).scope: Wraps ChatPage only. Chat is a self-contained domain with its own lifecycle.

ConfigContext (new, page-scoped).scope: Wraps ConfigEditorPage only. Editor state doesn't affect rest of app.

state.config: unknown — raw config object from server

state_management.why_no_zustand: Three contexts with clear boundaries. zustand adds a dependency for marginal DX gain over useReducer — not worth it at this scale (8 pages, <20 state fields total). If page count doubles or cross-page state grows complex, revisit.

api_service_layer.design: Thin fetch wrapper in api/client.ts. One file per domain in api/. No class instances, just functions.

exports.get<T>(path: string): Promise<T>: GET with auth header, JSON parse, error normalize
exports.post<T>(path: string, body?: unknown): P: POST with auth header, JSON body, error normalize
exports.postSSE(path: string, body: unknown): Re: POST returning stream reader for SSE chat

client.auth: Read AIC_API_KEY from env at build time (VITE_AIC_API_KEY). Inject as Bearer token if present.
client.error_handling: Catches non-2xx responses, normalizes to { status, message }. Network errors get message 'Server unreachable'.
client.base_url: Empty string — Vite proxy handles /api → localhost:6868 in dev. Production: same-origin.

chat.ts.sendMessage(message: string, conversatio: POST /api/chat, returns ReadableStream for SSE consumption

chat_sse_strategy.problem: SSE standard (EventSource) only supports GET. Chat needs POST (send user message in body). Must use fetch + ReadableStream.
chat_sse_strategy.solution: Manual SSE parsing over fetch ReadableStream. The server streams newline-delimited JSON or `data:` SSE frames on POST /api/chat.

server_contract.stream_format: SSE frames: `data: {json}\n\n` where json is either { type: 'token', content: '...' } or { type: 'done', usage: {...} } or { type: 'error', message: '...' }

flow: 5. Read chunks in loop: reader.read() → decode Uint8Array → split by '\n' → parse 'data:' frames
6. On 'token' frame: dispatch APPEND_STREAM_CHUNK (append to last assistant message)
7. On 'done' frame: finalize message, dispatch SET_STREAMING(false), extract usage for cost tracking
9. On reader.cancel() or component unmount: abort stream, clean up
client_implementation.abort_handling: Store AbortController ref. On unmount or new message send while streaming: controller.abort(). This kills the fetch.
client_implementation.reconnection: None — chat is request/response, not a persistent connection. Each message is a new stream.
client_implementation.buffer_management: Maintain a partial line buffer. SSE frames can split across chunk boundaries. Buffer until '\n\n' delimiter, then parse.

chat_sse_strategy.proxy_note: Vite dev proxy (already configured) passes /api to :6868. SSE works through the proxy — no special config needed. The proxy buffers by default in some setups; set proxy.sse = true in vite.config if chunks are delayed. Check vite.config.ts for the proxy config — may need to add { target, changeOrigin: true, configure: (proxy) => { proxy.on('proxyReq', ...) } } or use the `ws` option if WebSocket is needed later.

theme_architecture.approach: Dark-only. No light mode toggle. The CRT/pixel aesthetic IS the brand — adding a light theme would dilute it and cost maintenance for zero user value.

existing_system.colors: tailwind.config.js defines aic-* and status-* color tokens. These are the single source of truth.
existing_system.fonts: Press Start 2P for headings/labels. Monospace fallback for body text.
existing_system.effects: CRT scanlines (index.css), floating particles, neon box-shadows, pixel animations.
existing_system.panels: aic-bg-panel with aic-border + subtle inner shadow. Used everywhere.

changes_for_new_pages.chat_page: Messages use aic-bg-panel-dark for assistant bubbles, aic-bg-panel for user bubbles. Input bar: aic-bg-panel with aic-accent focus ring. Streaming indicator: aic-yellow blink-pixel animation.
changes_for_new_pages.config_page: Editor textarea: aic-bg-dark with monospace font, aic-text, aic-border. Validation: aic-green/aic-red StatusBadge. Save button: aic-accent bg.
changes_for_new_pages.tables_history_audit: DataTable: aic-bg-panel rows with aic-border-b. Hover: aic-bg-panel-dark. Sort indicators: aic-accent.
changes_for_new_pages.metric_cards_system_workers: MetricCard: aic-bg-panel with aic-accent value text, aic-text-dim label. Sparkline: aic-accent stroke.
changes_for_new_pages.charts_recharts: Recharts theme: bg transparent, grid stroke aic-border, line/bar fill aic-accent/aic-green/aic-yellow, axis tick aic-text-dim, tooltip bg aic-bg-panel.

theme_architecture.no_changes_to_tailwind_config: All needed colors already exist. The aic-* palette covers the full range. If a specific chart color is missing, add to aic-* in tailwind.config.js — don't use raw hex in components.
theme_architecture.css_architecture: index.css stays minimal — Tailwind handles layout, custom properties only for CRT effects. No CSS modules, no styled-components. Tailwind utility classes everywhere.

production.recharts: ^2.10.0 — charts for History/Analytics pages (lightest chart lib for React)
production.react-markdown: ^9.0.0 — render assistant messages in Chat (SSE output is markdown)

not_adding.zustand: React Context + useReducer is sufficient for 3 contexts. YAGNI.
not_adding.tailwind-merge: clsx + manual conflict resolution works. Not enough class conflicts to justify.
not_adding.clsx: Template literals handle conditional classes fine at this scale.
not_adding.react-hook-form: Config editor is a single textarea. Chat input is a textarea. No form library needed.
not_adding.monaco-editor: Overkill for JSON config editing. textarea + JSON.parse validation is enough.
not_adding.framer-motion (new): Already installed. Just use it in new pages.
not_adding.date-fns: Existing formatters.ts already handles timestamps. Duplicate utility.
